user.title: Connect to BirdNET-Go
user.description: Enter the address of your BirdNET-Go server. A token is only needed if the server is not reachable from Home Assistant's subnet without one.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach BirdNET-Go at that address.

abort.already_configured: This BirdNET-Go server is already configured.

init.title: BirdNET-Go options
init.description: Detections below the confidence floor are ignored for both entity state and events.\n\nThe audio level stream updates ~16x/second; the interval controls how often that is summarised into sensor state. Lower values mean more recorder writes. Set 0 to disable the sound level and clipping entities entirely.
